{{Youmay|the tree located on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]|the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Spirit Tree]]}}
The '''Spirit Tree''' was a tree that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], and it was reputed to be the largest tree on the world. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] thousands of individuals took shelter in a cavern that was located beneath the tree.
